title: A $1.5 Billion Wake-Up Call for Every AI Company on Wall Street
excerpt: Anthropic's $1.5 billion piracy settlement is reshaping how AI training data is valued, driving new licensing deals at Reddit and Cloudflare and raising inve...
content_html:
Key Points

  • Interested in Datavault AI Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • A federal judge granted final approval to Anthropic's $1.5 billion settlement with authors, putting a real market price on AI training data for the first time.

  • Data licensing deals, including Reddit's reported $60 million-a-year agreement with Google, show large platforms already treat user data as a recurring revenue line.

  • Investors seeking exposure can weigh small-cap pure-plays like Datavault AI alongside hyperscalers such as NVIDIA, Meta Platforms, and Alphabet that depend on a steady supply of licensed data.

A federal judge just approved a $1.5 billion settlement that puts a substantial legal cost on one source of artificial intelligence training material: pirated books

The judge separately ruled that training Claude on lawfully acquired books qualified as fair use. The settlement covers 482,460 works and is expected to pay roughly $3,000 per work, a much narrower group than the more than 7 million pirated books identified in Anthropic's broader library.

→ Volatility Is Back and These 3 Market Tollbooths Are Best Positioned to Profit

Dan Novaes, CEO of Mode Mobile, calls this a turning point for how markets value human data. His firm operates a rewards platform built on consented data-sharing, and he argues the settlement is the clearest signal yet that the human data market could grow into a market worth $1 trillion or more by 2033.

A Market Price Emerges for Training Data

For most of the last two and a half decades, Novaes says, the deal was simple. Platforms collected user activity, trained smarter systems on it, and users got a free product in return. That arrangement is now under legal pressure not just in the United States but in Germany and other jurisdictions applying stricter consent standards, echoing how GDPR reshaped data privacy years earlier.

→ This Tiny AI Supplier Could Be More Important Than the Chipmakers

The practical effect shows up in licensing deals already being signed. Reddit Inc (NYSE: RDDT) has reportedly licensed its user-generated content to Google for roughly $60 million a year — high-margin revenue built entirely on comments and posts the platform already owned.

Models Still Need Millions of Human Hours

Large language models still hallucinate, and Novaes says closing that gap increasingly requires specialized human input rather than more raw internet text. Companies now pay subject-matter experts, from physicists to physicians, to refine model responses in a process known as reinforcement learning from human feedback. Mercor, a marketplace connecting specialized workers to AI labs, reportedly grew from $1 billion to $2 billion in annualized revenue in four months this year, according to Novaes.

要点

  • 对 Datavault AI Inc. 感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • 联邦法官最终批准了 Anthropic 与作者达成的 15 亿美元和解协议，首次为人工智能训练数据确定了真实的市场价格。
  • 数据许可协议，包括 Reddit 报道的与谷歌每年 6000 万美元的协议，表明大型平台已经将用户数据视为经常性收入来源。
  • 寻求投资的投资者可以权衡 Datavault AI 等小型纯业务公司以及 NVIDIA、Meta Platforms 和 Alphabet 等依赖于稳定的许可数据供应的超大规模公司。

一位联邦法官刚刚批准了一项 15 亿美元的和解协议，该和解协议对人工智能培训材料的一个来源（盗版书籍）造成了巨额法律费用

法官单独裁定，对克劳德进行合法获得的书籍培训符合合理使用的条件。 和解协议涵盖 482,460 部作品，预计为每部作品支付约 3,000 美元，这一群体比 Anthropic 更广泛的图书馆中发现的超过 700 万本盗版图书要小得多。

→ 波动性又回来了，这 3 个市场收费站最有可能获利

Mode Mobile 首席执行官 Dan Novaes 称这是市场如何评估人类数据的转折点。 他的公司运营着一个建立在同意的数据共享基础上的奖励平台，他认为此次和解是迄今为止最明确的信号，表明人类数据市场到 2033 年可能会成长为价值 1 万亿美元或更多的市场。

训练数据的市场价格出现

诺瓦斯说，在过去二十年半的大部分时间里，这笔交易很简单。 平台收集用户活动，在其上训练更智能的系统，作为回报，用户获得免费产品。 这种安排现在不仅在美国而且在德国和其他采用更严格同意标准的司法管辖区都面临着法律压力，这与多年前 GDPR 重塑数据隐私的方式相呼应。

→ 这个小小的人工智能供应商可能比芯片制造商更重要

实际效果体现在已经签署的许可协议中。 据报道，Reddit Inc（纽约证券交易所股票代码：RDDT）已将其用户生成的内容以每年约 6000 万美元的价格授权给谷歌——高利润收入完全建立在该平台已经拥有的评论和帖子上。

模型仍然需要数百万个小时

大型语言模型仍然存在幻觉，诺瓦斯表示，缩小这一差距越来越需要专门的人类输入，而不是更多原始的互联网文本。 公司现在向从物理学家到医生等主题专家付费，让他们通过人类反馈的强化学习过程来完善模型响应。 据 Novaes 称，Mercor 是一个连接专业工作者和人工智能实验室的市场，今年四个月内年收入从 10 亿美元增长到 20 亿美元。
